description: WP-O6 Codex: Orks (11e) BOSS' AMMO RUNT (Warboss) through the real unit_selected_to_shoot window. Fixture ork11e_ab_shoot (codex roster units): the Warboss leads Boyz C, Witchseekers C ~9" away. A real click on the Boyz opens the window with the 0-CP ability cards (cost 'Ability'); a real click on 'Use on Warboss' spends no CP and flags the Warboss (once per battle). The window re-opens with Ammo Runts still on offer (declined). The Warboss' kustom shoota then shoots Witchseekers C (dispatched): its hit roll carries +1 with a 'Boss' Ammo Runt' ledger entry. Setup privilege: auto wound allocation.
